title: Blue Springs Manatee Tours & Wildlife Adventure Orlando
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries

blurb:
Join us and experience the Florida manatee guided kayak tour. Kayak Florida offers an informative and exciting kayak tour, with profesional guides that love what they do, and it shows. 
Blue springs is the winter sanctuary for hundreds of manatees as well as epic water birds and more. Our guides will intrigue you with some fun facts and interesting history of this Florida treasure. So what are you waiting for? BOOK NOW!
